title: M3.1 Infrastructure PIT Extension — Retroactive Audit Protocol
trigger: L-168 align_factor_direction PIT violation + M3 audit scope limitation discovery

protocol_overview.purpose: M3 Retroactive Audit (2026-04-19) was strategy-level code pattern scan only. Infrastructure functions (factor_db_connector.R internal logic) were outside audit scope. M3.1 extends to infrastructure layer.
protocol_overview.scope: Infrastructure PIT audit + PG2 active strategy re-measurement + direction flip impact quantification
protocol_overview.new_scope_addition: Infrastructure function PIT scan — all .load_ic_history() callers, factor_db_connector.R, factor_db_builder.R

steps.expected: C01 PASS, C07 PASS, C14 PASS

steps.r_code_outline:
# Load IC history, compare direction signs:
# full_sample_dir = ic_hist[, .(ic_sign = fifelse(mean(IC)>=0, 1, -1)), by=Factor_Name]
# expanding_dir   = ic_hist[Usable_Date <= '2020-01-31', same...]
# flip_factors    = full_sample_dir[expanding_dir, on='Factor_Name'][ic_sign != i.ic_sign]
steps.output: List of factors whose direction flips between full-sample and expanding-window at various sig_dates

steps.action: Backward compatibility test: align_factor_direction(dt, registry) without sig_date
steps.expected: Registry-only direction, no IC used, no error

phase_2_pg2_active_remeasurement.description: Re-run PG2 active strategies with fixed infrastructure to measure SR delta

strategies.action: Re-run with fixed factor_db_connector.R. Compare SR/CAGR/MDD.
strategies.critical_threshold: If SR < 1.00, PG2 active status requires immediate reassessment
strategies.judge_verification: Judge Gate 0-5 re-run on new results

strategies.additional_violation: C10 major (Size to AvgTV20) still pending fix
strategies.action: Fix C10 + infra C01 simultaneously. Re-run.

sr_1_193_status_update_protocol.if_sr_delta_lt_5pct: SR 1.193 status maintained with asterisk (*infra fix applied, delta < 5%)
sr_1_193_status_update_protocol.if_sr_delta_5_to_15pct: SR recalculated. New SR becomes official. Gap vector updated.
sr_1_193_status_update_protocol.if_sr_delta_gt_15pct: CRITICAL — fundamental reassessment of STR_1631. Governor rev9 triggered.

phase_3_full_scan_align_factor_direction.description: Scan all strategies that call align_factor_direction directly (without load_month_factors)

category_A_active_pipeline.action: Update factor_engine.R to pass sig_date to align_factor_direction. Or switch to load_month_factors().

category_B_archived_grade_a.description: Archived Grade A strategies (STR_1071, STR_1562, etc.)
category_B_archived_grade_a.action: Note in catalog that results were computed with full-sample direction. Re-run for reference only if needed.

category_C_hard_fail_archived.action: No action needed. Direction bug does not change Hard Fail status.

phase_4_judge_gate_13_integration.description: Integrate infra PIT scan into Judge Gate 13 (Signal-Portfolio Translation)

new_gate_13_1_checks.description: Verify strategy uses load_month_factors() (which auto-applies PIT-safe direction) OR passes sig_date to align_factor_direction()
Verify no direct .load_ic_history() call without Usable_Date filter in strategy code
new_gate_13_1_checks.pattern_to_detect: .load_ic_history() followed by mean(IC) without Usable_Date filter

lookahead_detector_extension.pattern: align_factor_direction(.*) without sig_date parameter when called in time-series loop context
lookahead_detector_extension.implementation: Forge task — add regex pattern to detect_lookahead()

phase_5_direction_stability_analysis.description: Quantify how many factors have unstable direction across time (expanding window sign flips)

analysis_design.method: For each factor, compute expanding mean_IC at each month from month 37 onward. Track sign changes.
analysis_design.output: direction_stability_report.csv: Factor_Name, N_Sign_Flips, First_Stable_Month, Final_Sign, Full_Sample_Sign, Mismatch
analysis_design.significance: Factors with many sign flips = direction unstable = IC-based direction unreliable for those factors. Registry direction may be preferable.

success_criteria.phase_2: STR_1631 SR delta measured and documented. Gap vector updated.
success_criteria.phase_3: All active pipeline strategies either use load_month_factors() or pass sig_date
success_criteria.phase_4: Judge Gate 13.1 infra PIT checks operational
success_criteria.phase_5: Direction stability report generated. Unstable factors flagged.
success_criteria.overall: PG2 SOFT_FREEZE lifted. SR number finalized (with or without delta).

rollback_plan.if_fix_causes_regression: git revert connector.R to pre-v2.0. Resume registry-only direction via Alternative B.
rollback_plan.registry_only_safe_mode: align_factor_direction(dt, registry) without sig_date = registry-only = always PIT-safe
rollback_plan.data_preservation: factor_ic_monthly.parquet unchanged. Only connector logic modified.
